selection_reason: Highly resolved commercial perfume advertisement featuring dramatic floral explosion, strong contrast, and clear campaign typography.

analysis.composition: Asymmetrical balance with the faceted bottle anchored lower-left against an exploding rose, counterweighted by right-aligned typography in the negative space.
analysis.negative_space: Dark, textured void on the right utilized effectively for legible white text placement.
analysis.lighting: Dramatic studio lighting with high contrast; sharp specular highlights on the geometric glass facets and soft, directional light defining the rose petals.
analysis.typography: Clean, sans-serif and serif mix in white; prominent '007' logo lockup with supporting tagline and URL, distinctly separate from the product container.
analysis.information_density: Moderate; focuses on brand identity, product name, and evocative tagline without clutter.

selection_reason: Professionally resolved flat-lay still life featuring perfume and candle with elegant stationery props and integrated handwritten campaign copy.

analysis.composition: Geometric flat-lay arrangement utilizing overlapping rectangular envelopes and cards to frame the products diagonally.
analysis.negative_space: Structured by layered cream and black paper elements, creating distinct zones.
analysis.lighting: Soft, diffused top-down studio lighting with gentle, natural drop shadows.
analysis.typography: Handwritten script campaign copy ('Will you be my valentine?') placed directly on a prop envelope.

selection_reason: High-quality dynamic product shot capturing the spray mechanism in action against a clean gradient background. Excellent reference for minimalist perfume photography and liquid texture rendering.

analysis.composition: Diagonal orientation of the bottle creates dynamic movement, balanced by the spray plume extending into the upper left negative space.
analysis.negative_space: Generous gradient grey space surrounds the subject, emphasizing the fine mist particles.
analysis.lighting: Crisp studio lighting with high specular highlights on the glass and metal atomizer; soft drop shadow anchors the floating object.
analysis.information_density: Low; focus is entirely on the product form and function.

selection_reason: Professionally resolved multi-brand perfume still life with strong directional lighting, textured props, and cohesive warm palette; useful as a design reference for editorial fragrance campaigns.

analysis.composition: Asymmetrical arrangement of multiple fragrance bottles and a travel atomizer on travertine blocks, framed by draped fabrics and diagonal light shafts.
analysis.negative_space: Moderate negative space in the upper left and lower foreground, balanced by heavy drapery on the right.
analysis.lighting: Hard, directional sunlight creating sharp diagonal shadows and high-contrast highlights across the scene.
analysis.typography: None outside of container labels; relies entirely on product packaging lettering.
analysis.information_density: Medium; multiple products displayed with scattered textural props (caramel/resin chunks).

selection_reason: Professionally resolved perfume still-life with high-end lighting and material detail, suitable as a design reference for luxury fragrance campaigns.

analysis.typography: None. Text is limited to the brand label printed directly on the glass container.
analysis.information_density: Low, focusing entirely on the product form and material.

selection_reason: Professionally resolved perfume still-life with strong monochromatic color grading and elegant floral staging; high utility for lighting and composition reference.

analysis.composition: Centralized vertical alignment of the bottle framed by organic floral curves at the base, creating a pedestal effect against a clean gradient background.
analysis.negative_space: Generous upper negative space with a smooth radial gradient, focusing attention on the spherical cap and bottle silhouette.

selection_reason: Highly resolved conceptual still-life featuring a Cartier fragrance integrated with vintage Edison bulbs. Strong visual metaphor and premium execution make it an excellent design reference.

analysis.negative_space: Deep teal gradient background provides clean negative space around the illuminated subjects.
analysis.lighting: Dramatic practical lighting from the glowing filaments combined with a soft central backlight creating a halo effect behind the bottle.
analysis.typography: None. The text on the bottle is container labeling, not campaign typography.
analysis.information_density: Low, focused entirely on the visual concept and product.

selection_reason: Professionally resolved perfume still-life with clear brand identity, high-quality lighting, and cohesive pastel color palette suitable for design reference.

analysis.composition: Clustered arrangement of four faceted glass bottles, three upright and one horizontal, creating depth and visual interest against a seamless background.
